description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the OAuthClientDao component within the OrangeHRM project. It tests CRUD operations and retrieval functions for OAuth client data, using mock data fixtures.

classes.name: OAuthClientDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing OAuthClientDao functionalities such as saving, retrieving, counting, and deleting OAuth client entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DAO object and populates test fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testSaveOAuthClient
methods.description: Tests persisting a new OAuthClient entity and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testGetOAuthClientList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of OAuthClient entities and verifies their attributes.

methods.name: testGetOAuthClientCount
methods.description: Checks the total count of OAuthClient entities returned.

methods.name: testGetOAuthClientById
methods.description: Tests fetching a single OAuthClient by its ID, including null response for nonexistent ID.

methods.name: testGetOAuthClientByClientId
methods.description: Tests fetching a client via its client ID string, including null for invalid IDs.

methods.name: testDeleteOAuthClients
methods.description: Tests deletion of OAuthClients by ID and verifies the remaining entities.
